title: Just Juice Fusion Blood Orange & Mango On Ice 50/50 E-Liquid
description: The latest Fusion flavour from vape legends Just Juice is a juicy cocktail of ripe tropical and citrus fruits. Fusion Blood Orange and Mango On Ice features punchy flavours of rich, zesty blood orange and sunny-sweet mango, layers of creamy passion fruit and tangy guava, and a little extra citrus edge. The cool, delicate rush of menthol on the exhale adds a refreshing top note to all that fantastic fruit and finishes this exquisitely fresh and vibrant e-liquid off to perfection. This e-liquid’s 50% VG, 50% PG ratio delivers an extremely satisfying vape with a perfect balance of flavour and cloud production and is ideally suited to pod kits and starter kits .
